arxiv-1910-00758.title: Local invariants of non-commutative tori
arxiv-1910-00758.creator: Fedor Sukochev, Dmitriy Zanin
arxiv-1910-00758.description: Abstract . We consider a generic curved non-commutative torus extending the notion of conformally deformed non-commutative torus from [ 7 ] . In general, a curved non-commutative torus is no longer represented by a spectral triple, not even by a twisted spectral triple.

arxiv-2103-00812.title: Enhancement for Robustness of Koopman Operator-based Data-driven Mobile Robotic Systems
arxiv-2103-00812.creator: Lu Shi, Konstantinos Karydis
arxiv-2103-00812.description: Abstract Koopman operator theory has served as the basis to extract dynamics for nonlinear system modeling and control across settings, including non-holonomic mobile robot control. There is a growing interest in research to derive robustness (and/or safety) guarantees for systems the dynamics of which are extracted via the Koopman operator.

arxiv-2209-04109.title: MATT: A Multiple-instance Attention Mechanism for Long-tail Music Genre Classification
arxiv-2209-04109.creator: Xiaokai Liu ∗ , Menghua Zhang §
arxiv-2209-04109.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaokai Liu ∗ , Menghua Zhang §. Imbalanced music genre classification is a crucial task in the Music Information Retrieval (MIR) field for identifying the long-tail, data-poor genre based on the related music audio segments, which is very prevalent in real-world scenarios. Most of the existing models are designed for class-balanced music datasets, resulting in poor performance in accuracy and generalization when identifying the music genres at the tail of the distribution.

arxiv-2309-16774.title: Subset-Reach Estimation in Cross-Media Measurement
arxiv-2309-16774.creator: Chenwei Wang, Jiayu Peng, Rieman Li, Ying Liu
arxiv-2309-16774.description: Abstract We propose two novel approaches to address a critical problem of reach measurement across multiple media – how to estimate the reach of an unobserved subset of buying groups (BGs) based on the observed reach of other subsets of BGs. Specifically, we propose a model-free approach and a model-based approach.

arxiv-2402-16385.title: Proton spin in double-logarithmic approximation
arxiv-2402-16385.creator: B. I. Ermolaev
arxiv-2402-16385.description: Abstract Proton is a composite particle, so its spin S P S_{P} is made from the spins of the partons which the proton consists of. The discrepancy between S P = 1 / 2 S_{P}=1/2 and the experimentally detected sum of the parton spins was named Proton Spin Puzzle.

arxiv-2501-06629.title: Simple algebras and exact module categories
arxiv-2501-06629.creator: Kevin Coulembier, Mateusz Stroiński, Tony Zorman
arxiv-2501-06629.description: Abstract . We verify a conjecture of Etingof and Ostrik, stating that an algebra object in a finite tensor category is exact if and only if it is a finite direct product of simple algebras. Towards that end, we introduce an analogue of the Jacobson radical of an algebra object, similar to the Jacobson radical of a finite-dimensional algebra.

arxiv-2601-02828.title: Collapsed Structured Block Models for Community Detection in Complex Networks
arxiv-2601-02828.creator: Marios Papamichalis, Regina Ruane
arxiv-2601-02828.description: Abstract Community detection seeks to recover mesoscopic structure from network data that may be binary, count-valued, signed, directed, weighted, or multilayer. The stochastic block model (SBM) explains such structure by positing a latent partition of nodes and block-specific edge distributions.

britannica-1911-fenton-elijah.title: Fenton, Elijah (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-fenton-elijah.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-fenton-elijah.description: Article 'Fenton, Elijah' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Shelton near Newcastle-under-Lyme, of an old Staffordshire family, on the 25th of May 1683. He graduated from Jesus College, Cambridge, in 1704, but was prevented by religious scruples from taking orders. He accompanied the earl of Orrery to Flanders as private secretary, and on returning to England became assistant in a school at Headley, Surrey, being soon afterwards appointed master of the free grammar school at Sevenoaks in Kent.

pmc-10670486.title: Surgical Management of Adult Brainstem Gliomas: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-10670486.creator: Tamara Ius, Giuseppe Lombardi, Cinzia Baiano, Jacopo Berardinelli, Andrea Romano, Nicola Montemurro, Luigi Maria Cavallo, Francesco Pasqualetti, Alberto Feletti
pmc-10670486.description: The present review aims to investigate the survival and functional outcomes in adult high-grade brainstem gliomas (BGSs) by comparing data from resective surgery and biopsy. MEDLINE, EMBASE and Cochrane Library were screened to conduct a systematic review of the literature, according to the PRISMA statement.

pmc-10696709.title: Treatment of brainstem and fourth ventricle lesions by the full neuroendoscopic telovelar approach
pmc-10696709.creator: Long Zhou, Hangyu Wei, Zhiyang Li, Huikai Zhang, Ping Song, Li Cheng, Wenju Wang, Pan Lei, Qianxue Chen, Zaiming Liu, Hui Ye, Daofa Sun, Qiang Cai
pmc-10696709.description: ObjectiveTo explore the surgical techniques, advantages, and disadvantages of neuroendoscopic telovelar approach in the treatment of brainstem and fourth ventricle lesions.MethodsThe clinical data of 5 patients treated by neuroendoscopic telovelar approach from March 2020 to March 2022 were analyzed retrospectively.ResultsAmong the 5 patients, there were 3 cavernous hemangiomas in pontine arm and 2 tumors in brainstem and fourth ventricle.

pmc-11434276.title: AraC Functional Suppressors of Mutations in the C-Terminal Domain of the RpoA Subunit of the Escherichia coli RNA Polymerase
pmc-11434276.creator: Dominique Belin, Jordan Costafrolaz, Filo Silva
pmc-11434276.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). coli, transcriptional activation is often mediated by the C-terminal domain of RpoA, the α subunit of RNA polymerase. Random mutations that prevent activation of the arabinose PBAD promoter are clustered in the RpoA C-terminal domain (α-CTD). We have isolated functional suppressors of rpoA α-CTD mutations that map to araC, the main transcriptional regulator of ara genes, or to the PBAD promoter. No mutation was found in the DNA regulatory region between araC and PBAD.

pmc-11618522.title: The chain mediating effect of self-respect and self-control on the relationship between parent-child relationship and mobile phone dependence among middle school students
pmc-11618522.creator: Aolun Wang, Shuyuan Guo, Ziyi Chen, Yang Liu
pmc-11618522.description: This study aims to examine the impact of parent-child relationship on smartphone dependence among middle school students and explore the mediating role of self-respect and self-control. A cross-sectional survey was conducted using the Parent-Child Relationship Scale, Smartphone Dependence Scale, Self-Respect Scale, and Self-Control Scale with a sample of 2,311 middle school students.

pmc-12467503.title: Levodopa–Carbidopa–Entacapone Intestinal Gel for Advanced Parkinson’s Disease—Results from a Monocentric Study Evaluating Both Motor and Non-Motor Manifestations
pmc-12467503.creator: Mihaiela Lungu, Violeta Diana Oprea, Luminița Lăcrămioara Apostol, Eva Maria Elkan, Ana Maria Ionescu, Anca Tudor, Lucian Andrei Zaharia, Marc Ekker, Ruth G Perez
pmc-12467503.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Parkinson’s disease (PD) in advanced stages becomes, over time, a significant challenge, as oral medication becomes ineffective, and it may become necessary to switch to device-assisted therapy (DAT). This should be personalized according to the stage of the disease, the cognitive status of the patients, the association of frailty syndrome or other comorbidities, the support in care from the family, etc.

pmc-12661965.title: Social Determinants of Health and Barriers in Accessing Eye Care for Refugees in the Greater Toronto Area
pmc-12661965.creator: Mohammed Abbas, Khaldon F Abbas, Mariam Issa, Eric S Tam, Sohel Somani
pmc-12661965.description: PurposeTo evaluate ocular health status, vision-related quality of life, and access to eye care services among a multi-ethnic refugee population in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA).MethodsParticipants completed a structured survey capturing demographic, medical, and vision-related data. Descriptive statistics were employed to summarize and interpret the responses. Canadian population data were sourced from Statistics Canada and National Vision Health Reports.

pmc-13437868.title: From the Gobi to the Sahel: Can China’s anti-desertification model work in Africa?
pmc-13437868.creator: Annah Lake Zhu, Jesse Rodenbiker, Xiaona Guo, Amadou Ndiaye, Yongdong Wang, Yuan You, Zinabu Bora, Xiaosong Li, Jiaqiang Lei, Ruishan Chen
pmc-13437868.description: China’s assistance with Africa’s Great Green Wall offers a critical test case for its eco-developmental approach to combating desertification. Unlike Western-backed conservation models, which focus primarily on ecological restoration, China’s strategy—refined through its Three North Shelterbelt Program—focuses on eco-developmentalism, integrating tree planting with large-scale infrastructure, renewable energy, and livelihood transformation through a broad developmental vision.

pmc-13530787.title: Poster 263. Revision Posterior Labral Repair: Outcomes and Risk Factors for Failure
pmc-13530787.creator: Aidan M McQuade, Conor F McCarthy, Hannah P Gibbs, Scott M Feeley, Valentina Ramirez, Benjamin W Hoyt, Jonathan F Dickens
pmc-13530787.description: Objective:Arthroscopic posterior labral repair is the most common surgical treatment for posterior instability. However, for patients with recurrent instability, little is known about outcomes after revision arthroscopic stabilization. The purpose of this study was to evaluate outcomes after revision posterior labral repair in a young, active population, and to evaluate risk factors for subsequent clinical failure.

pmc-13715050.title: Heterovalent, Homometallic Rings: Synthesis, Optical, and EPR Studies of {TiIV 7TiIII} Complexes
pmc-13715050.creator: Selena J Lockyer, Lubomir Loci, Yingzhao Ma, Matthew P Stevens, Grigore A Timco, George F S Whitehead, Richard E P Winpenny, Alice M Bowen, Eric J L McInnes
pmc-13715050.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We report a new class of heterovalent, homometallic ring complexes, with {TiIV 7TiIII} cores: [py‐CH2NH2Et][Ti7TiO8(O2CR)16] (R = tBu and cyclopropyl). The compounds are made from [Ti(OiPr)4] reacted with carboxylic acid and py‐CH2NHEt. We also show that {TiIV 7TiIII} rings can be generated by photoreduction of {TiIV 8} precursors in the presence of a suitable sacrificial electron donor, of relevance to photocatalysts.

uslaw-usc-t12-s1829c.title: 12 U.S.C. § 1829c — Making online banking initiation legal and easy
uslaw-usc-t12-s1829c.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s1829c.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 16 (Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Affiliate The term “affiliate” has the meaning given the term in section 1841 of this title. (2) Driver’s license The term “driver’s license” means a license issued by a State to an individual that authorizes the individual.
